q.bn: ঠিক করো: "Let's discuss about the plan."

why.en: "Discuss" never takes a preposition — it's followed directly by the object.
why.bn: "Discuss"-এর পরে কখনো preposition বসে না — সরাসরি object আসে।

q.en: Fix: "He is married with my sister."
q.bn: ঠিক করো: "He is married with my sister."

options.en: He is married to my sister.
options.bn: He is married to my sister.

options.en: He is married at my sister.
options.bn: He is married at my sister.

options.en: He is married for my sister.
options.bn: He is married for my sister.

options.en: He is married on my sister.
options.bn: He is married on my sister.

why.en: The correct preposition is "married to", not "married with".
why.bn: সঠিক preposition হলো "married to", "married with" না।

q.bn: ঠিক করো: "I can able to swim."

why.en: Only one modal-type expression is used at a time — "can swim" or "am able to swim", never both stacked together.
why.bn: একবারে একটাই modal-type expression ব্যবহার হয় — "can swim" বা "am able to swim", দুটো একসাথে না।

q.en: Fix: "This method is much more better."
q.bn: ঠিক করো: "This method is much more better."

options.en: This method is much more good.
options.bn: This method is much more good.

why.en: Don't stack two comparative markers — "better" is already a comparative, so it only needs "much", not "more" too.
why.bn: দুটো comparative marker একসাথে বসানো যায় না — "better" নিজেই comparative, তাই শুধু "much" লাগে, "more" লাগে না।

q.bn: ঠিক করো: "I am angry on you."

why.en: The correct preposition after "angry" (about a person) is "with", not "on".
why.bn: "Angry"-এর পরে (একটা মানুষের ক্ষেত্রে) সঠিক preposition হলো "with", "on" না।
